Supply the AI side of multiple proposals and bids, including the agentic AI use cases and potential-savings analysis that contributed to a deal win; AI business cases with costed investment options, executive proposals for governed agentic pilots, SOW reviews, architecture at client security reviews, and a co-designed agentic architecture on AWS Bedrock AgentCore.

Run agentic use-case analysis with customers and internal teams, consolidating 150+ AI use-case submissions into 20 agent families and separating real agent candidates from simple workflows to shape pilots, platform choice and roadmaps.

Originated the role-based AI bootcamp proposal and a learn-build-deploy-scale capability model, taken forward with VP sponsorship; recommended go-to-market packaging of the Workspace agents; authored a 12-week Copilot Enablement Playbook built on peer champions, leaders modeling usage and measured adoption.
